tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background. Machine-shop putty, the grey-beige of an old manual and a painted shop floor. Never pure white.

tokens.name: paper-2
tokens.usage: Set-apart surfaces: card stubs, table headers, notes, inset panels.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text, headings, 2px structural borders, the hard offset shadow. 13:1 on paper in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: captions, metadata, part numbers. 5.7:1 on paper, 5.1:1 on paper-2 (light). 6.7:1 and 5.9:1 (dark).

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Input borders, dividers that must be seen, the dot grid (3:1+ on paper).

tokens.name: rule-faint
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines only. Never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: enamel
tokens.usage: Machine-tool green, the identity colour. Large blocks, the cover, the open-shop dot, the selected row tint. Not for small text on paper in light (3.8:1).

tokens.name: enamel-deep
tokens.usage: The START button. Primary button fill, with on-enamel text (5.6:1 light, 7.3:1 dark). One per view.

tokens.name: on-enamel
tokens.usage: Text and icons on enamel-deep fills.

tokens.name: enamel-ink
tokens.usage: Green when it IS the text: links, inline emphasis, focus rings. 5.0:1 on paper light, 7.3:1 dark.

tokens.name: stop
tokens.usage: The STOP button red. Errors, Few-seats-left tags, warnings that matter. Text-safe on paper (4.7:1 light, 6.2:1 dark). Never a primary action.

tokens.name: brass
tokens.usage: Brass fittings. Hazard stripes, tape, small accent blocks. Always behind ink text (5.1:1), never as text on paper.

tokens.name: brass-ink
tokens.usage: Brass when it is text: the Woodshop category. 4.8:1 on paper light, 8.3:1 dark.

tokens.name: on-brass
tokens.usage: Text and the dark stripe on brass fills.

tokens.name: gauge
tokens.usage: Pressure-gauge blue, a supporting cool colour. Electronics category, info notes. 5.8:1 on paper light, 7.4:1 dark.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Page titles and the home hero. One per page.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Bring a project, or don't. Someone here will have one you can help with.
styles.usage: Running text. Generous size: people read this on a phone with sawdust on it.

styles.name: body-small
styles.sample: Members get 24/7 access after a shop orientation.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: UPPERCASE part-number labels, tags, eyebrows above headings, table headers.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Times, prices, dimensions, specs — anything a person might measure or compare.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its value; icon to text.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside tags; between related lines.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile; button horizontal padding; base grid-paper pitch.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Default. Cards, panels, tables, notes — cut square like sheet stock.

tokens.name: radius-1
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs: a deburred edge, not a pill.

tokens.name: radius-hole
tokens.usage: Punched holes, rivets, status dots. The only round thing.

tokens.name: shadow-block
tokens.usage: Hard offset shadow, no blur — a block set on the bench. Buttons and featured cards only.

tokens.name: shadow-none
tokens.usage: Everything else. Depth comes from borders, not blur.

tokens.name: border-hair
tokens.usage: Dividers, table rules, the grid.

tokens.name: border-firm
tokens.usage: Cards, buttons, inputs: the outline of a part.
